provenance: FICO original dictionary, pinned challenge participant mirror; mixed representation of HELOC, not an independent corpus
preprocessing: Existing load_tabular_three_way: training-only numeric median imputation, categorical mode imputation, one-hot encoding, then standardization including dummy columns; seed0 60/20/20 split
domain_note: Categorical blocks are standardized one-hot vertices. Use the fitted affine inverse before simplex relaxation and restore affine transform for classifier/geometry. Do not treat category codes as ordered scalar distances. No arbitrary binning of numerical predictors.
